name: A flight through Menethil

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Slim tries to flee the inn and is subdued at Menethil Harbor.
description: In Menethil Harbor, Slim hears that Elling’s inquiry has reached the inn. He tries to slip away, and the encounter becomes a brief struggle outside the crowded waterside rooms. The Wetlands are not merely a crossing between continents here; they are the place where a quiet investigation finally meets a suspect face to face. Slim is subdued, and the questions can begin.
